---
title: "Branding"
subtitle: "The trishula mark, the colours, and where the logo work stands"
---

The trident (triśūla) is the project's mark — kernel shield, userspace engine, control plane as its three prongs. Logo and visual-identity work is **parked as a research artefact**, not a marketing stream: it resumes when an image-generation pass produces candidates that survive review. Current working state lives in the project docs directory (`eBPF-WAF/logos/`, internal).

- Two SVG rounds exist and **both were rejected**: v1 (geometric icons) read as a menorah; v2 (ink/linocut) is closer but not right.
- Vibe references: the *kailash-os* avatar (linocut trishula on a mountain) — wrong direction here — and a *kalatopi*-style persona (deliberately not adopted).
- Next attempt: a dedicated image-generation retry brief with the trishula's actual iconography (Śiva's trident as a weapon-implement, bladed outer prongs, single curved rear prong) and constraints: readable at 32 px avatar size, single colour + background, no ornament, no gradient.

This page simply records where branding stands so it does not drift or become a distraction. The site itself keeps the quarto documentation default — that is deliberate for a research project.
